title: BEM Mixins for element and modifier are inverted

comments.body: Woops. This would be a breaking change to modify them. Or we could duplicate :D

Oops...
![Sorry...](https://media.giphy.com/media/xFOc3rYIGE3aE/giphy.gif)

I don't think we can duplicate (this will be sooo strange). Let's keep that for the next breaking release :)

Edit: Well, at least we're consistent, and everything is documented. Still, it's a shame we did not use the "official" way.
Just to be clear, this will be fixed in a 2.0.0 release "at some point"

Actually if you read the broader litterature, the convention is Block Element Modifier but then you can more or less choose whatever you want since it's only syntax not semantics...
https://en.bem.info/method/naming-convention/#alternative-naming-schemes
Yes, it's only syntax, and nothing is really broken with that syntax. I'm wondering if we really need to change it with 2.0. This will be a CSS breaking change for sure, but do we really need it?
indeed the link from @bobylito clearly state we can go wild with naming
